## Brief

Surface: vertical story ad, 1080×1920
Job: a thumb-scrolling reader understands the offer in the first second
Constraint: the brand teal and the logo lockup
Falsifier: with the sound off, the offer is not readable before 1.0 s

## Taste

Ban: confetti bursts; floating phone mockups tilted at 30°
